newsitem.title: UK: INSIGHT - Cocoa aims higher but danger of downmove.
newsitem.headline: INSIGHT - Cocoa aims higher but danger of downmove.

text.p: SEPT Close * Support * Resist * RSI14 * MA10 * MA30
Cocoa has been trying to push higher, but there remains the danger of a fall if it loses momentum, analysts said.
Traders called it to open 15 stg down.

Cocoa has been trying to break above its late June trading range, having seen a new high during the day on Tuesday, Susan Rigg, technical analyst at Chart Analysis, noted. But there was still a good chance it could come back, she said.
"A close below 1,130 stg would not be good news," she said.
There was "plenty of historical support below 1,075," she said, if initial support at 1,140 and then 1,095 were to break.
"If it starts coming down, it could come down with a bump," she said.
However, if cocoa were to avoid the danger points there was also a good chance it could go up, she said.
New York cocoa futures ended down sharply in rollercoaster trading on Tuesday, as an afternoon round of speculative selling sent prices toward session lows, traders said.
